+    # --- Helper methods for tree algorithm handlers ---

+    @classmethod
+    def _prepare_pos_var_for_add_sibling(cls, pos):
+        """Standardize `pos` parameter for add_sibling operations (used by handlers)."""
+        if not pos:
+            pos = "last-sibling"
+        if pos not in ("first-sibling", "left", "right", "last-sibling", "sorted-sibling"):
+            raise InvalidPosition("pos must be 'first-sibling', 'left', 'right', 'last-sibling' or 'sorted-sibling'")
+        if cls.node_order_by and pos != "sorted-sibling":
+            raise InvalidPosition("pos must be 'sorted-sibling' if node_order_by is enabled")
+        if not cls.node_order_by and pos == "sorted-sibling":
+            raise MissingNodeOrderBy("node_order_by must be set for sorted operations")
+        return pos
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _prepare_pos_var_for_move(cls, pos):
+        """Standardize `pos` parameter for move operations (used by handlers)."""
+        if not pos:
+            pos = "last-child"
+        if pos not in ("first-child", "last-child", "sorted-child", "first-sibling", "left", "right", "last-sibling", "sorted-sibling"):
+            raise InvalidPosition("pos must be one of 'first-child', 'last-child', 'sorted-child', 'first-sibling', 'left', 'right', 'last-sibling' or 'sorted-sibling'")
+        if cls.node_order_by and pos not in ("sorted-child", "sorted-sibling"):
+            raise InvalidPosition("pos must be 'sorted-child' or 'sorted-sibling' if node_order_by is enabled")
+        if not cls.node_order_by and pos in ("sorted-child", "sorted-sibling"):
+            raise MissingNodeOrderBy("node_order_by must be set for sorted operations")
+        return pos
